policy: Third-party downloads and everything derived from them stay gitignored under assets/cursed-slammers/ (main checkout; worktrees symlink it). The repo is public: never commit them. The owner chose H1 on 2026-10-25 ('just try rendering this head') and downloaded it himself (Sketchfab needs a signed-in account).

assets.notes: Photogrammetry (114 photos, PhotoScan) of a gorilla-face sculpture at Wilhelma Zoo, Stuttgart; the sculptor is not named. 559,884 tri / 281,109 verts, one 8192x8192 texture, a front mask (no back, no jaw). The scan is the uploader's CC-BY work; the sculpture's own copyright is the owner's call (02-research-asset.md 1.1). Add the attribution line to CREDITS.md if anything derived from it is ever shipped.
